text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need to worry that much. Sure, 
we can't be overly optimistic, but it's 
not like she won't be able to run 
anymore."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No one can take this world from me. No 
matter who it is, or what it is.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Shall we go prove that right now?
choice_data_list: I bet you could do it, though...
I feel like you could do it, though...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Shall we go prove that right now?
choice_data_list: I bet you could do it, though...
I feel like you could do it, though...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...You're certainly very blunt, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, you aren't me. Only I can truly 
understand myself.
choice_data_list:
Still, there's a side of you that only I 
can see.

Still, there's a side of you only I get to 
see.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Ghk!
choice_data_list: I can't right now, Mr. C.B.
I can't right now, Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha, looks like it. I suppose the 
proof will have to wait."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mr. C.B. took some time off to 
rest until her injury healed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I make sure to tell Mr. C.B. at least this 
much: "If anything happens, stop 
immediately."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer. Well, shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: (—I can't run.)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(My body is heavy, it hurts. I can't step 
forward, I can't dig in...)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Was the turf always this far away?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed over to her as she stood 
paralyzed with shock. Though she 
immediately took time off to rest... it 
would take a long time before she could 
return.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to grab some grub. What 
should I eat?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
? We're in the middle of getting ready 
right now, aren't we? Come help me pick 
one out.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Dishes packed with the vital nutrients 
needed to recover from an injury, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's heal this injury right up. And 
then we'll prove it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the type to let an injury like 
this stop me... right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mr. C.B. returned from her injury 
at an unprecedented speed, proving her 
convictions to the world!
